- Checked game/plugin limits, SD reads/copies/closes, compressed payloads and stack-safe boot; restored small headerless plugins and directory records after failed loads.

# Changelog

## DS Style Merkin Mix 8.3.2

**For the EZ-FLASH OMEGA Definitive Edition Rev. A and Rev. B only.** Do not install on the original OMEGA or the newer OMEGA Definitive Edition B / BLUE.

### New features and improvements

- Freed 832 bytes of scarce working RAM by keeping an unchanged built-in NES patch in read-only storage.

### Fixes

- Made NES detection and patch handling safer for incomplete or malformed files, and prevented stale detection results from carrying over to another game.
- Prevented patch data from spilling beyond its loading buffer when preparing NOR games, and added a final capacity check before patch writes can modify cartridge memory.
- Corrected plugin boot preparation to protect the active launch stack and keep the required boot and decompression code available while the game starts. Raw and compressed payloads are checked before they replace working memory.
- Restored support for small valid plugin files that do not have a GBA header, and corrected the plugin name passed in launch arguments.
- Failed PSRAM loads now rebuild directory records before the menu uses that memory again.
- Kernel staging copies now detect close errors, reject oversized file-size values, and remove detected incomplete output instead of reporting a successful copy.
- Improved save loading for oversized files and stopped loading on a close error before changing cartridge save memory.
- Improved save, backup and artwork handling for valid Chinese filenames and mixed-case SYSTEM/SAVER folder names.
- Tightened size checks for cheat-file identity and game-code mapping, preventing malformed size values from bypassing their limits.
- Tightened validation of marked transparency artwork while retaining ordinary artwork and header-code compatibility.

### Earlier features

- Gave NOR game writing a DS Style progress window with a percentage and progress bar, a dedicated background, and the usual username and clock on the top bar.

- Integrated FrankieT19's separate v8.0 Start-screen and interface work: refined selection markers, menu sounds, and pop-ups. Added a loading ring, and a theme-matched launch fade.
- Integrated FrankieT19's v8.0 Auto theme, grouped artwork controls under View, Open SYSTEM access, Boot to controls, and double-tap Select for favorites.
- Highly optimized menu artwork rendering by skipping redundant transparency scans for opaque artwork, while retaining compatibility with marked transparent thumbnails.
- Made header-code artwork appear faster in large game folders, with a safe fallback when the fast lookup is unavailable.
- Added artwork support for NOR games in nested folders and clearer messages when NOR installation, erasing or catalog updates fail.
- Added selected-game artwork and clearer status text to the Saving Game Data presentation, based on FrankieT19's v8.0 work.
- **DS Style v7.5 foundation (FrankieT19):** launcher, themes, artwork workflows, language support, animated carousels, side-preview options and launch pulse.
- Added horizontal, vertical and List + Art views; favorites and recently played lists; title and box artwork; themes; configurable borders, rounded corners and carousel alignment; and a text/Markdown viewer.
- Added mirrored artwork lookup, built-in and custom thumbnail fallbacks, marked-thumbnail transparency, console icons, wide and square system artwork, and the `CUSTOM Only` rounded-corner option.
- Added optional Remember cheats with localized labels through **exploitz86**, and collapsible cheat groups based on **SkillerCMP's** work and adapted by **exploitz86**. Remember cheats is off by default.
- Added browser wrap settings, Clean list and List folders controls, 12/24-hour clock options, Hide system files, and support for installing kernels from `/SYSTEM/KERNELS`.
- Added Thai and Chinese language support, customizable launcher text and Start screen layouts, full-screen theme support, and the DS Style Merkin Mix build number.
- Added configurable Start screen sources and shortcuts, empty-folder/favorites messages, folder and file custom thumbnails, and built-in guidance for settings and menus.
- Added multi-language settings/help categories, cheat-screen refinements, and improved menu, pop-up, carousel, list, sound and input behavior across the DS Style lineage.

### Earlier fixes

- Removed the brief black progress strip during external-plugin launches, giving games such as NES and Game Gear titles the same clean themed transition as GB/GBC launches.
- Made PSRAM game and emulator loading safer: oversized files and combinations that exceed available memory are rejected, and incomplete or failed SD reads stop the launch instead of starting a partial image.
- Corrected loading across PSRAM memory boundaries, including games placed after emulator plugins, and cleared unused space at the end of partial loading blocks for consistent results.
- Fixed thumbnail cache handling when switching to list views, preventing artwork overwritten by list drawing from being reused as a valid cached image.

- Made settings updates and game-save exports safer by staging the new file first and retaining the previous complete file if an SD write fails.
- Corrected artwork selection and alignment in the startup save-recovery screen, and improved compatibility with valid title artwork from more image tools.
- Restored NOR menu button hints; improved format confirmation, cancellation and progress feedback; and ensured deleting the newest NOR game clears its saved data.
- Restored "Clean list" on\off options, aligned help headings and LED values, and restored header-code artwork for games in the SD-card root.
- Improved display of longer translated NOR error messages.
- Preserved marked-art transparency and corrected animated carousel wrap transitions; fixed collapsed-cheat selection, visible-row scrolling and stale-row behavior (including fixes by **exploitz86**).
- Improved SD save and save-state handling, save recovery, long filenames and folders, malformed cheat-file handling, ROM patching and NOR installation/deletion feedback.
- Improved compatibility with large or fragmented SD folders, corrected recent-list limits and empty-list navigation, reduced menu memory use, and fixed software-boot behavior.
- Fixed translated text and settings handling, Chinese and accented-character rendering, custom-background scrolling, help/clock redraws, cheat-screen redraws and carousel border flicker.
- Improved thumbnail loading/redraw, file browsing, menu navigation, startup timing, and settings migration; optimized artwork drawing while retaining marked transparency.
- Corrected save-type labels, translated settings, game launching with BIOS disabled, and handling of fragmented game and save-state files.
- Earlier DS Style releases also improved file copy, backups, thumbnail loading, folder browsing and cheat-file stability across supported kernel variants.

Thanks to **FrankieT19** for the DS Style v7.5 foundation and separately authored v8.0 interface features listed above; to **exploitz86**, **SkillerCMP**, **Sterophonick**, and the EZ-FLASH team for their contributions to this project and its lineage. **aidiadayo** contributed Thai language support. See [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/voluptuary/ezfode-dssmm-kernel/blob/v8.3.2/CREDITS.md) for provenance.

### Validation and known limitations

Production builds and software regression checks cover the new fixes. No additional Rev. A/B hardware verification has been recorded for these audit changes. Existing flash-polling and interrupted NOR-catalog/SD-file replacement limitations remain; avoid powering off during writes.

Download **ezkernelnew.bin** below. GitHub supplies source archives automatically.

# Changelog

## DS Style Merkin Mix 8.3.1 — Original OMEGA Test 3

> **ORIGINAL EZ-FLASH OMEGA ONLY — HARDWARE UNTESTED.**
>
> This continues the Original OMEGA Merkin Mix port. Source, build and host checks have passed, but it has **not been tested on an Original OMEGA cartridge**. Installation, booting, gameplay, saving, plugins, cheats/save states and NOR writing still need hardware verification.
>
> **Do not install on the OMEGA Definitive Edition Rev. A or Rev. B, the newer OMEGA Definitive Edition B / BLUE, or another cartridge model.** The separate Definitive Edition 8.3.1 release remains the stable release for Rev. A/B.

### Improvements in Test 3

- Freed 832 bytes of working RAM by keeping an unchanged built-in patch in read-only storage.

### Fixes in Test 3

- Made NES detection and patch handling safer for incomplete or malformed input, including games being written to NOR.
- Added a final capacity check before patch writes can select or modify cartridge memory.
- Corrected valid Chinese filenames being mistaken for folder separators when saving, creating backups or finding artwork.
- Tightened validation of marked transparency artwork while retaining ordinary artwork and header-code compatibility.
- Corrected oversized save-file handling and stopped loading before changing cartridge save memory if closing the input file fails.

### Earlier features

- Brought over Merkin Mix's highly optimized artwork lookup and menu rendering paths while retaining transparency compatibility. Cached carousel motion handles opaque and transparent artwork, and CUSTOM artwork lookup avoids repeatedly scanning the entire artwork list.
- Added reliable indexed file identities for long filenames, with readable display names and separate aliases for opening the correct game or folder. Header-code artwork can use a validated fast lookup, with the ordinary lookup retained as a fallback.
- Added **CUSTOM Only** rounded corners, with the artwork choice retained correctly across carousel motion, scaled List + Art previews and popup restoration.
- Added editable **Clean list** display and **On, Not SYSTEM** wrapping. Settings accept the existing localized/legacy spellings and retain the selected scope.
- Added optional per-extension artwork defaults, such as `CUSTOM/gg.bmp`, and full-size missing-art previews for supported games and plugins.
- Added SD-side artwork records for NOR games, preserving their original artwork folder and long filename without changing the cartridge catalog format.
- Updated the splash and help artwork to the current Merkin Mix assets.

- Merkin Mix filename-matched artwork for supported systems beyond GBA, mirrored folders and long-filename artwork support in `SYSTEM/IMGS` and `SYSTEM/IMGS2`.
- Marked-thumbnail transparency alongside ordinary opaque images and GBA header-code artwork, including Start-screen previews, favorites and recent games.
- Optional **Remember cheats**, off by default, with per-game selections and collapsible groups. This builds on **exploitz86's** remembered-cheat work and the group-menu foundation by **SkillerCMP**, adapted by **exploitz86**.
- DS Style NOR writing progress with a percentage/bar, dedicated background, username and clock.
- **Original OMEGA DS Style v8.0 foundation (FrankieT19):** DS menus, Start screen, themes, menu sounds, animated carousels, selection effects and launch presentation.
- List, List + Art, horizontal and vertical views; title and box artwork; configurable side previews; favorites, recent games and last-played startup.
- Light, Dark and clock-based Auto themes, accent colors and readable settings in `SYSTEM/SETTINGS.TXT`.
- Multiple languages, including Chinese and Thai, and the text/Markdown viewer.


### Earlier fixes

- Corrected stale thumbnail metadata when changing views, so list workspace reuse cannot leave a carousel preview marked as valid.
- Corrected the bounds check used when installing carousel drawing code into video memory.
- Added checks for raw and compressed plugin payloads before copying them into working RAM, including incomplete or malformed compressed data. Corrected the compressed-plugin decoder selection and the plugin name passed in launch arguments.
- Failed PSRAM loads now rebuild directory records before the menu uses that memory again.
- File copies now reject oversized size values, incomplete reads/writes and close errors, and remove detected incomplete output files.
- Corrected a missing Thai language-table entry that shifted subsequent labels, and retained localized remembered-cheat labels. Added readable confirm/back hints to game-management and delete popups.

- Removed the brief black progress strip during external-plugin launches.
- Added checks for game/plugin size limits, incomplete SD reads and loading across PSRAM memory boundaries, stopping before a partial image launches.
- Made SD saves and settings replacement safer with staged writes and retention of the previous complete file when a write fails.
- Hardened NOR input files, available-space/catalog checks and game-list scanning, with consistent final-block padding.
- Corrected patch copying across memory boundaries, bounded staged NOR patch copies and checked reads while preparing patched games.
- Corrected cheat-group selection and visible rows when groups collapse, including fixes contributed by **exploitz86**.


### Test-build limitations

- No Original OMEGA hardware results exist. Software checks and mocked storage/bus behavior cannot establish physical compatibility, performance, flash success or recovery from power loss.
- Native PSRAM games and generic plugin/game combinations remain limited to 32 MiB. NOR deletion retains the newest-title restriction.
- Original NOR programming APIs do not report physical success, and their polling remains without a timeout. Cartridge metadata is not power-loss atomic. Artwork hints and cheat snapshots are best-effort metadata; ordinary save/settings replacement has separate safeguards.

### New fixes since v8.0.0

- Optimized the CPU-copy / DMA-copy transparency check for artwork rows. Aligned pixel pairs are scanned in batches to quickly select DMA copying for opaque rows, while CPU copying still skips transparent pixels exactly as before. This build checks candidate pixel pairs as it finds them, avoiding an extra pass while retaining exact `0x8000` transparency handling. Hardware testing found menu responsiveness about the same as the previous build. Please report your findings in the [GBAtemp DS Style thread](https://gbatemp.net/threads/ds-style-a-nintendo-ds-inspired-custom-kernel-for-ez-flash-omega-omega-de.680565/).

- **v7.4.3:** Added SD-card mirrored artwork lookup with custom and built-in thumbnail fallbacks, selective transparency for marked BMP thumbnails, and refreshed console icons and startup artwork.

### Fixes through v8.0.0

- **v8.0.0:** Prevented highly fragmented ROM and RTS files from overflowing the fixed FPGA FAT-table transfer buffer. Files whose fragment tables exceed the supported capacity are rejected instead of sending a corrupted table. The fix passed host regression tests; physical testing with a highly fragmented SD card has not been reported.
- **v7.4.6b:** Kept the kernel image within the supported 2 MiB limit, with oversized builds failing reliably instead of leaving a stale image that could appear successful. Improved save handling so failed first-time saves do not leave incomplete files and errors checking existing saves are not mistaken for missing saves.
- **v7.4.6b:** Improved cartridge-flash operation checks and feedback, refreshed the game list after successful formatting, avoided unnecessary cartridge-info writes, reduced NOR format progress redraw overhead while retaining full erase verification, and fixed format confirmation/progress redraws to clear the full menu row.
- **v7.4.6b:** Fixed cheat-file parsing so values from one entry cannot carry over into the next. This feature has not been hardware-tested; please report any issues.
- **v7.4.6b:** Restored the established settings-save polling behavior while retaining newer checks for other cartridge records, and consolidated settings readers while removing unused code. Subsequent hardware testing on v7.4.6b has not reproduced the reported settings-persistence issue.
- **v7.4.5:** Fixed game launch with Enable BIOS off that was broken with a previous fix; improved long directory-name display, selection, save paths, and artwork lookup when folder aliases differ; reduced repeat directory scans during thumbnail browsing; and updated launcher stack/heap placement for FatFs long-filename handling.
- **v7.4.3:** Hardened NOR catalog bounds, title sizes, source reads, block padding, metadata commits, interrupt restoration, and trim-probe arithmetic. Limited deletion to a verified newest title, fixed NOR progress redraws, hardened SD sector and save/RTS I/O checks, bounded paths and malformed cheat data, fixed PSRAM writes across 8 MiB boundaries and rejected odd-address writes, updated NOR guidance, and aligned installer regression expectations with the shipped packages.

releases.body:
## Feature updates

- Added mirrored artwork lookup for all games on the SD card, with existing custom and built-in thumbnail fallbacks. My fork of the DS Style Thumbnail Scraper linked below automates this process. There is still a 255 file limit per folder.
- Added selective transparency for marked BMP thumbnails and corrected stale-art redraws across launcher views. To take advantage of the selective transparency you need to use my fork of the [DS Style Thumbnail Scraper](https://github.com/voluptuary/ds-style-multisystem-thumbnail-scraper/releases).
- Refreshed the built-in console icons and startup splash artwork.

## NOR improvements

- Fixed the garbled menu redraw behind the NOR format progress counter.
- NOR deletion is limited to the newest packed title. The Delete action is hidden when catalog and flash-range checks cannot verify that title as safe to remove. This also fixes the menu lockup when attempting to delete an older title.
- Hardened NOR catalog and installation handling: validate catalog bounds and title sizes, require complete source and header reads before flash operations, pad the final partial block with erased bytes, and commit catalog metadata only after source I/O succeeds.
- Restore the prior interrupt state on all NOR catalog scan exits and validate trim-probe I/O and boundary arithmetic.
- Updated the NOR deletion guidance across the supported languages.

## Other fixes

- Hardened SD sector I/O so failed reads cannot be mistaken for valid save data, and failed writes correctly shut down the SD interface.
- Checked save and RTS file sizes, read/write counts, and close results; failures no longer report success or apply stale/partial data. Failed writes preserve pending recovery, and failed first-time save creation is cleaned up.
- Bounded folder paths, cheat filenames, malformed cheat records, and fixed-width save/RTS names; initialized folder counts on SD recount paths.
- Corrected PSRAM patch writes across 8 MiB page boundaries and reject odd-address writes.
- Updated browser installer regression expectations to match the shipped v7.4 package filenames.

These changes and fixes were completed with the assistance of AI.
